title: ap_context() clones large JSON Value on every call
description: src/activitypub.rs:56-58. ap_context() returns AP_CONTEXT.clone(), which deep-clones a multi-level serde_json::Value tree on every actor/outbox/featured response. The AP context is ~20 nested JSON objects. Since serde_json::Value::clone() recursively allocates, this is a non-trivial allocation in the hot path of every AP endpoint. Consider returning a reference or using Arc<Value> to avoid the deep clone.
